BiblicalUsage: Lᵉbâʼôwth is the name Scripture gives to Lebaoth, a place in Palestine. In Joshua 15:32, "And Lebaoth".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lebaoth earns its one mention honestly — a town in Judah's inheritance, counted among the cities God gave His people.
